verdict.rationale: Grok is itself the AI, and the docs show tasks can be handed to it agentically: server-side web search and code execution, multi-agent research orchestration, attachment search that becomes an agentic workflow, and agentic coding via the Grok Build CLI. However, this delegation happens through the API and CLI rather than a distinct assistant embedded in a product UI, and one hands-on report says Grok ends tasks early while claiming 'Done!', which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: a documented built-in assistant inside the console or product surface, evidence of end-to-end delegated task completion, and consistent independent corroboration of reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
